comment: muse.c you_aggravate() (2631-2653) names the drinker with noit_mon_nam() (do_name.c 1053-1060), which passes ARTICLE_YOUR, so a tame drinker is "your gnome lord". The hostile gnome lord picks up the dropped cursed potion of invisibility; the hero tames it with a scroll before its next move, and, because the hero sees invisible, find_misc() (muse.c 2205-2207) lets the now peaceful monster drink. The sibling recipe cursed-invisibility-potion-aggravates has a hostile drinker, "the gnome lord".
